<!-- wp:html -->
<!doctype html><html lang="vi"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Đăng ký đội thi — Vietnam Robotics Championship 2026–2027</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --vrc-navy:#062f69;
  --vrc-navy-2:#0a407f;
  --vrc-red:#ef0017;
  --vrc-red-2:#c80016;
  --vrc-ink:#10233e;
  --vrc-muted:#667085;
  --vrc-line:#dce5ef;
  --vrc-bg:#f5f8fc;
  --vrc-white:#ffffff;
  --vrc-radius:22px;
  --vrc-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(6,47,105,.14);
  --vrc-container:min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;color:var(--vrc-ink);background:var(--vrc-white);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;line-height:1.6}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}

.vrc-container{width:var(--vrc-container);margin-inline:auto}
.vrc-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-kicker:before{content:"";width:34px;height:3px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:skewX(-28deg)}
.vrc-section{padding:88px 0}
.vrc-section--soft{background:var(--vrc-bg)}
.vrc-section-title{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.4rem);line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:12px 0 18px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-section-lead{max-width:760px;color:var(--vrc-muted);font-size:1.08rem;margin:0}

/* header */
.vrc-site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(6,47,105,.10)}
.vrc-header-inner{height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.vrc-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:210px}
.vrc-brand img{width:205px;max-height:62px;object-fit:contain}
.vrc-nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;font-weight:700;color:#17375d;font-size:.88rem}
.vrc-nav a{position:relative;padding:28px 0;white-space:nowrap}
.vrc-nav a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:20px;height:3px;background:var(--vrc-red);transition:.22s}
.vrc-nav a:hover:after{right:0}
.vrc-header-cta{padding:12px 18px!important;background:var(--vrc-red);color:white;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(239,0,23,.18)}
.vrc-header-cta:after{display:none}
.vrc-menu-toggle{display:none;margin-left:auto;background:var(--vrc-navy);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px}

/* hero */
.vrc-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 78% 18%,rgba(239,0,23,.17),transparent 28%),
  linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42 0%,#062f69 55%,#0a407f 100%);color:white;padding:96px 0 86px}
.vrc-hero:before,.vrc-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;transform:skewX(-32deg);opacity:.95}
.vrc-hero:before{width:580px;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);right:-80px;top:140px}
.vrc-hero:after{width:430px;height:3px;background:#fff;right:35px;top:168px;opacity:.55}
.vrc-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.18fr .82fr;align-items:center;gap:70px}
.vrc-season{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vrc-season-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--vrc-red);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(239,0,23,.14)}
.vrc-hero h1{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(4rem,8.2vw,7.4rem);line-height:.82;margin:24px 0 22px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.005em}
.vrc-hero h1 span{display:block;color:#fff}
.vrc-hero h1 strong{color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-hero-copy{font-size:1.12rem;max-width:720px;color:#dbe8f7}
.vrc-hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:32px}
.vrc-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 21px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;transition:.2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.vrc-btn--primary{background:var(--vrc-red);color:white;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(239,0,23,.27)}
.vrc-btn--primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#ff1328}
.vrc-btn--ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);color:white;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.vrc-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.vrc-hero-card{position:relative;background:white;border-radius:28px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.24);transform:rotate(1deg)}
.vrc-hero-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:82px;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);top:-4px;right:28px;transform:skewX(-30deg)}
.vrc-hero-logo{width:100%;max-width:560px;margin:auto}
.vrc-hero-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.vrc-meta-box{padding:12px 10px;border-radius:12px;background:#f4f7fb;text-align:center;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-meta-box b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:1.55rem;line-height:1}
.vrc-meta-box span{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:#60718a;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}

/* partners */
.vrc-partner-strip{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line);background:#fff}
.vrc-partners{min-height:116px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.vrc-partner-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7a8798}
.vrc-partner-logos{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:42px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vrc-partner-logos img{max-width:172px;max-height:55px;object-fit:contain}

/* program cards */
.vrc-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:42px}
.vrc-card{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:var(--vrc-radius);padding:28px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(6,47,105,.05);transition:.2s}
.vrc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vrc-navy),var(--vrc-red))}
.vrc-card-no{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:4.6rem;line-height:1;color:#e8eef6;position:absolute;right:18px;top:8px;font-weight:800}
.vrc-card h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;margin:12px 0 10px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-pill{display:inline-flex;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef4fb;color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vrc-card p{color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:14px 0 0}

/* timeline */
.vrc-timeline{margin-top:46px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;position:relative}
.vrc-timeline:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:5%;right:5%;top:19px;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vrc-navy),var(--vrc-red))}
.vrc-step{position:relative;padding:0 16px 18px;text-align:center}
.vrc-step-dot{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--vrc-navy);margin:0 auto 16px;position:relative;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #f5f8fc}
.vrc-step:last-child .vrc-step-dot{border-color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-step time{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--vrc-red);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.vrc-step h4{font-size:1rem;margin:6px 0;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-step p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:0}

/* feature */
.vrc-feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.vrc-tech-panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42,#0b417d);min-height:410px;border-radius:30px;padding:40px;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-tech-panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -60px 58px 120px;height:6px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:rotate(-12deg)}
.vrc-tech-panel:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:50%;right:-70px;bottom:-70px;box-shadow:0 0 0 45px rgba(255,255,255,.035),0 0 0 90px rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.vrc-tech-panel h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:3.2rem;line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 16px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-tech-panel p{color:#dce9f8;position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:500px}
.vrc-stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:28px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-stat{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:17px;border-radius:15px}
.vrc-stat b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2.1rem;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.vrc-stat span{font-size:.78rem;color:#c8d8eb;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:700}
.vrc-checks{display:grid;gap:15px;margin-top:30px}
.vrc-check{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.vrc-check i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(239,0,23,.09);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--vrc-red);font-style:normal;font-weight:900}
.vrc-check b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-bottom:3px}
.vrc-check span{color:var(--vrc-muted);font-size:.94rem}

/* CTA */
.vrc-cta{background:#061f46;color:white;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vrc-cta:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:70%;height:8px;background:var(--vrc-red);right:-12%;top:38px;transform:skewX(-32deg)}
.vrc-cta-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-cta h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4.7rem);line-height:.95;margin:0}
.vrc-cta p{color:#cbd8e8;max-width:620px}

/* footer */
.vrc-footer{background:#03142f;color:#c8d5e6;padding:56px 0 24px}
.vrc-footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:52px}
.vrc-footer h4{color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.09em;margin:0 0 16px}
.vrc-footer p,.vrc-footer a{font-size:.92rem;color:#aebed2}
.vrc-footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.vrc-footer-logo{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;max-width:260px;margin-bottom:20px}
.vrc-footer-partners{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.vrc-footer-partners img{max-width:130px;max-height:42px;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);opacity:.92}
.vrc-footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-top:42px;padding-top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font-size:.82rem;color:#7f94ae}

/* posts */
.vrc-content{width:var(--vrc-container);margin:60px auto 90px}
.vrc-post-card{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line);padding:28px 0}
.vrc-post-card h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .vrc-hero-grid,.vrc-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-hero-card{max-width:680px}
  .vrc-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
  .vrc-timeline:before{left:19px;right:auto;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;height:auto}
  .vrc-step{text-align:left;padding-left:68px}
  .vrc-step-dot{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;margin:0}
  .vrc-footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:82px;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;padding:14px 20px 24px;box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(6,47,105,.12);flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0}
  .vrc-nav.is-open{display:flex}
  .vrc-nav a{padding:12px 0}
  .vrc-nav a:after{display:none}
  .vrc-menu-toggle{display:block}
}

@media (max-width:680px){
  :root{--vrc-container:min(100% - 28px,1180px)}
  .vrc-section{padding:66px 0}
  .vrc-header-inner{height:72px}
  .vrc-brand img{width:160px}
  .vrc-nav{top:72px}
  .vrc-hero{padding:70px 0 62px}
  .vrc-hero h1{font-size:3.9rem}
  .vrc-hero-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-partners{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:22px 0}
  .vrc-partner-logos{justify-content:flex-start;gap:24px}
  .vrc-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-cta-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
  .vrc-footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-footer-bottom{flex-direction:column}
}

/* v1.2 content system */
.vrc-hero-sub{margin:-8px 0 14px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em}
.vrc-two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:70px;align-items:start}
.vrc-copy-lg{font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-copy-lg p:first-child{margin-top:0}
.vrc-text-link,.vrc-card-link{display:inline-flex;margin-top:18px;color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-text-link:hover,.vrc-card-link:hover{color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-card-image{height:180px;margin:-28px -28px 22px;overflow:hidden;background:#eaf0f7}
.vrc-card-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.vrc-program-cards .vrc-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.vrc-program-cards .vrc-card-link{margin-top:auto;padding-top:18px}
.vrc-event-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:52px;align-items:center}
.vrc-event-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin:30px 0}
.vrc-event-facts div{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:14px;padding:15px 16px;background:#fff}
.vrc-event-facts span{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:#7b8797;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800}
.vrc-event-facts b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-top:4px}
.vrc-event-image{border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-event-image img{width:100%;min-height:460px;object-fit:cover}
.vrc-btn--navy{background:var(--vrc-navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(6,47,105,.18)}
.vrc-btn--navy:hover{background:#0a407f;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.vrc-timeline--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.vrc-resource-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:36px}
.vrc-resource-card{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:7px;background:#fff;transition:.2s}
.vrc-resource-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-resource-card span{grid-column:1 / -1;color:var(--vrc-red);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800}
.vrc-resource-card b{color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-resource-card i{font-style:normal;color:var(--vrc-red);font-size:1.3rem}
.vrc-news-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-news-card{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(6,47,105,.05)}
.vrc-news-card>img{width:100%;height:190px;object-fit:cover}
.vrc-news-body{padding:22px}
.vrc-news-body time{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.vrc-news-body h3{color:var(--vrc-navy);line-height:1.25;margin:8px 0;font-size:1.18rem}
.vrc-news-body p{color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:0}
.vrc-news-body>a{display:inline-flex;margin-top:14px;color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-partner-groups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-partner-groups>div{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;min-height:150px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.vrc-partner-groups span{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:800;color:#7a8798}
.vrc-partner-groups img{max-width:190px;max-height:60px;object-fit:contain;margin-top:24px}
.vrc-cta-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.vrc-cta-note{font-size:.82rem;color:#cbd8e8}

/* inner pages */
.vrc-page-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42,#062f69 65%,#0a407f);color:#fff;padding:74px 0 68px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vrc-page-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-8%;top:38%;width:55%;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:skewX(-30deg)}
.vrc-page-hero .vrc-kicker{color:#fff}
.vrc-page-hero h1{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,7vw,6rem);line-height:.92;text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0;color:#fff;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-page-hero p{font-size:1.12rem;color:#dbe8f7;position:relative;z-index:2;margin:0}
.vrc-content-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(260px,.7fr);gap:60px;align-items:start}
.vrc-prose{font-size:1.02rem;color:#37475d}
.vrc-prose h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:2.1rem;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;margin:34px 0 14px}
.vrc-prose h2:first-child{margin-top:0}
.vrc-prose ul{padding-left:22px}
.vrc-prose li{margin:7px 0}
.vrc-side-card{background:var(--vrc-bg);border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;position:sticky;top:110px}
.vrc-side-card h3{color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:1.3rem;margin-top:0}
.vrc-side-card ul{padding-left:20px;margin-bottom:0}
.vrc-side-card--image img{border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:18px}
.vrc-info-callout{margin-top:28px;padding:20px;border-left:5px solid var(--vrc-red);background:#f7f9fc;border-radius:0 14px 14px 0}
.vrc-info-callout b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-bottom:5px}
.vrc-info-callout span{color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-org-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:36px}
.vrc-org-grid article{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px}
.vrc-org-grid img{height:55px;max-width:190px;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:25px}
.vrc-org-grid h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--vrc-navy);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.vrc-org-grid p{color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-number-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-number-grid div{padding:24px;background:var(--vrc-navy);border-radius:18px;color:#fff}
.vrc-number-grid b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2.8rem;line-height:1}
.vrc-number-grid span{display:block;color:#d7e4f3;margin-top:8px;font-size:.88rem}
.vrc-icon-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:30px}
.vrc-icon-list div{padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;font-weight:700;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-note{margin-top:24px;color:var(--vrc-muted);font-style:italic}
.vrc-link-box{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-top:28px;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:14px;background:#f7f9fc}
.vrc-link-box span{font-weight:700;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-link-box a{color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.vrc-roadmap-list{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:34px}

            <li data-vi="Thiết kế, lắp ráp, lập trình robot hoặc từng tham gia/đạt giải tại các cuộc thi Robotics." data-en="Have designed, assembled or programmed robots, or previously joined/won robotics competitions.">Thiết kế, lắp ráp, lập trình robot hoặc từng tham gia/đạt giải tại các cuộc thi Robotics.</li>
            <li data-vi="Đội thuộc trường vùng khó khăn, vùng sâu vùng xa hoặc học sinh có hoàn cảnh đặc biệt khó khăn vươn lên đam mê STEM." data-en="Teams from disadvantaged or remote-area schools, or students overcoming special hardship to pursue STEM.">Đội thuộc trường vùng khó khăn, vùng sâu vùng xa hoặc học sinh có hoàn cảnh đặc biệt khó khăn vươn lên đam mê STEM.</li>
            <li data-vi="Tích cực tổ chức hoặc tham gia các hoạt động lan tỏa giáo dục STEM tại nhà trường và địa phương." data-en="Actively organize or take part in activities spreading STEM education at school and locally.">Tích cực tổ chức hoặc tham gia các hoạt động lan tỏa giáo dục STEM tại nhà trường và địa phương.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>
        <article class="vrc-spon-card">
          <h3 data-vi="Hồ sơ đăng ký" data-en="Application">Hồ sơ đăng ký</h3>
          <p class="vrc-spon-sub" data-vi="Chọn 1 trong 2 hình thức:" data-en="Choose 1 of 2 formats:">Chọn 1 trong 2 hình thức:</p>
          <ul>
            <li data-vi="Video (2–3 phút): giới thiệu đội, câu chuyện vượt khó hoặc các hoạt động STEM cộng đồng." data-en="Video (2–3 min): introduce the team, a story of overcoming hardship, or community STEM activities.">Video (2–3 phút): giới thiệu đội, câu chuyện vượt khó hoặc các hoạt động STEM cộng đồng.</li>
            <li data-vi="Bài viết (dưới 1.000 từ + 3–5 ảnh): mô tả hành trình đam mê và kế hoạch chế tạo robot." data-en="Article (under 1,000 words + 3–5 photos): describe the team's passion journey and robot-building plan.">Bài viết (dưới 1.000 từ + 3–5 ảnh): mô tả hành trình đam mê và kế hoạch chế tạo robot.</li>
          </ul>
          <p class="vrc-spon-note" data-vi="Lưu ý: Đội đăng ký theo trường cần có Thư xác nhận từ Ban Giám hiệu và người giám sát trên 18 tuổi đồng hành suốt mùa giải." data-en="Note: teams registering under a school need a confirmation letter from school leadership and a supervisor over 18 accompanying them throughout the season.">Lưu ý: Đội đăng ký theo trường cần có Thư xác nhận từ Ban Giám hiệu và người giám sát trên 18 tuổi đồng hành suốt mùa giải.</p>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="vrc-spon-actions">
        <a class="vrc-btn vrc-btn--primary" href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSew66vRpmnRVNXmx4_uMflHD8MXfz_FGV4RhObl6WRgwJbl_A/viewform" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-vi="Đăng ký nhận tài trợ →" data-en="Apply for sponsorship →">Đăng ký nhận tài trợ →</a>
        <a class="vrc-btn vrc-btn--ghost-dark" href="https://docs.google.com/file/d/1PaaYP2a6YajvBdS9iF3Cp9C8vK9EFisg/edit?usp=docslist_api&filetype=msword" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-vi="Mẫu giấy cam kết nhà trường" data-en="School commitment letter template">Mẫu giấy cam kết nhà trường</a>
      </div>

      <div class="vrc-info-callout vrc-info-callout--soft">
        <b data-vi="Tiếp nhận hồ sơ" data-en="Applications received by">Tiếp nhận hồ sơ</b>
        <span data-vi="Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (Đại diện SEPA) · Hotline +84 834 899 888 · robotics@sepa.org.vn / nguyenmanhcuong@sepa.org.vn"
              data-en="Mr. Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (SEPA representative) · Hotline +84 834 899 888 · robotics@sepa.org.vn / nguyenmanhcuong@sepa.org.vn">Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (Đại diện SEPA) · Hotline +84 834 899 888 · robotics@sepa.org.vn / nguyenmanhcuong@sepa.org.vn</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

</main>

  <footer class="vrc-footer"><div class="vrc-container">
      <div class="vrc-footer-grid">
        <div><p>Vietnam Robotics Championship 2026–2027 — cuộc thi robotics giáo dục lấy học sinh, sinh viên làm trung tâm, triển khai theo hệ thống RECF tại Việt Nam.</p></div>
        <div><h4>Hệ thống & đơn vị tổ chức</h4><p>Robotics Education & Competition Foundation (RECF)</p><p>Trung tâm Hỗ trợ Khởi nghiệp Sáng tạo Quốc gia (NSSC)</p><p>Liên minh Thúc đẩy Giáo dục STEM (SEPA)</p></div>
        <div><h4>Liên hệ</h4><p>Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường<br><a href="tel:+84834899888">+84 834 899 888</a></p><p><a href="mailto:robotics@sepa.org.vn">robotics@sepa.org.vn</a></p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="vrc-footer-bottom"><span>© 2026 Vietnam Robotics Championship.</span><span>Design • Build • Code • Compete</span></div>
    </div></footer>
<script>(function(){var b=document.querySelector('.vrc-menu-toggle'),n=document.querySelector('.vrc-nav');if(b&&n){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=n.classList.toggle('is-open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o?'true':'false');});}})();</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.getElementById('vrc-gt');
  if(!root) return;
  var btns = root.querySelectorAll('.vrc-lang-btn');
  function setLang(lang){
    root.setAttribute('data-lang', lang);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', lang);
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-vi][data-en]').forEach(function(el){
      var v = el.getAttribute('data-'+lang);
      if(v !== null){
        var a=el.querySelector('a');
        if(a && (el.tagName==='P')){ el.childNodes[0].nodeValue=v; }
        else { el.innerHTML=v; }
      }
    });
    btns.forEach(function(b){ var on=b.getAttribute('data-lang')===lang; b.classList.toggle('is-active',on); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false'); });
    try{localStorage.setItem('vrcLang',lang);}catch(e){}
  }
  btns.forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click',function(){ setLang(b.getAttribute('data-lang')); }); });
  var saved='vi'; try{saved=localStorage.getItem('vrcLang')||'vi';}catch(e){}
  setLang(saved);
})();
</script>
</body></html>

<!doctype html><html lang="vi"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Đăng ký đội thi — Vietnam Robotics Championship 2026–2027</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --vrc-navy:#062f69;
  --vrc-navy-2:#0a407f;
  --vrc-red:#ef0017;
  --vrc-red-2:#c80016;
  --vrc-ink:#10233e;
  --vrc-muted:#667085;
  --vrc-line:#dce5ef;
  --vrc-bg:#f5f8fc;
  --vrc-white:#ffffff;
  --vrc-radius:22px;
  --vrc-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(6,47,105,.14);
  --vrc-container:min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;color:var(--vrc-ink);background:var(--vrc-white);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;line-height:1.6}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}

.vrc-container{width:var(--vrc-container);margin-inline:auto}
.vrc-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-kicker:before{content:"";width:34px;height:3px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:skewX(-28deg)}
.vrc-section{padding:88px 0}
.vrc-section--soft{background:var(--vrc-bg)}
.vrc-section-title{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.4rem);line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:12px 0 18px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-section-lead{max-width:760px;color:var(--vrc-muted);font-size:1.08rem;margin:0}

/* header */
.vrc-site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(6,47,105,.10)}
.vrc-header-inner{height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.vrc-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:210px}
.vrc-brand img{width:205px;max-height:62px;object-fit:contain}
.vrc-nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;font-weight:700;color:#17375d;font-size:.88rem}
.vrc-nav a{position:relative;padding:28px 0;white-space:nowrap}
.vrc-nav a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:20px;height:3px;background:var(--vrc-red);transition:.22s}
.vrc-nav a:hover:after{right:0}
.vrc-header-cta{padding:12px 18px!important;background:var(--vrc-red);color:white;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(239,0,23,.18)}
.vrc-header-cta:after{display:none}
.vrc-menu-toggle{display:none;margin-left:auto;background:var(--vrc-navy);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px}

/* hero */
.vrc-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 78% 18%,rgba(239,0,23,.17),transparent 28%),
  linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42 0%,#062f69 55%,#0a407f 100%);color:white;padding:96px 0 86px}
.vrc-hero:before,.vrc-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;transform:skewX(-32deg);opacity:.95}
.vrc-hero:before{width:580px;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);right:-80px;top:140px}
.vrc-hero:after{width:430px;height:3px;background:#fff;right:35px;top:168px;opacity:.55}
.vrc-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.18fr .82fr;align-items:center;gap:70px}
.vrc-season{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vrc-season-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--vrc-red);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(239,0,23,.14)}
.vrc-hero h1{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(4rem,8.2vw,7.4rem);line-height:.82;margin:24px 0 22px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.005em}
.vrc-hero h1 span{display:block;color:#fff}
.vrc-hero h1 strong{color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-hero-copy{font-size:1.12rem;max-width:720px;color:#dbe8f7}
.vrc-hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:32px}
.vrc-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 21px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;transition:.2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.vrc-btn--primary{background:var(--vrc-red);color:white;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(239,0,23,.27)}
.vrc-btn--primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#ff1328}
.vrc-btn--ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);color:white;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.vrc-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.vrc-hero-card{position:relative;background:white;border-radius:28px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.24);transform:rotate(1deg)}
.vrc-hero-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:82px;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);top:-4px;right:28px;transform:skewX(-30deg)}
.vrc-hero-logo{width:100%;max-width:560px;margin:auto}
.vrc-hero-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.vrc-meta-box{padding:12px 10px;border-radius:12px;background:#f4f7fb;text-align:center;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-meta-box b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:1.55rem;line-height:1}
.vrc-meta-box span{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:#60718a;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}

/* partners */
.vrc-partner-strip{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line);background:#fff}
.vrc-partners{min-height:116px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.vrc-partner-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7a8798}
.vrc-partner-logos{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:42px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vrc-partner-logos img{max-width:172px;max-height:55px;object-fit:contain}

/* program cards */
.vrc-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:42px}
.vrc-card{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:var(--vrc-radius);padding:28px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(6,47,105,.05);transition:.2s}
.vrc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vrc-navy),var(--vrc-red))}
.vrc-card-no{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:4.6rem;line-height:1;color:#e8eef6;position:absolute;right:18px;top:8px;font-weight:800}
.vrc-card h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;margin:12px 0 10px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-pill{display:inline-flex;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef4fb;color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vrc-card p{color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:14px 0 0}

/* timeline */
.vrc-timeline{margin-top:46px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;position:relative}
.vrc-timeline:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:5%;right:5%;top:19px;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vrc-navy),var(--vrc-red))}
.vrc-step{position:relative;padding:0 16px 18px;text-align:center}
.vrc-step-dot{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--vrc-navy);margin:0 auto 16px;position:relative;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #f5f8fc}
.vrc-step:last-child .vrc-step-dot{border-color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-step time{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--vrc-red);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.vrc-step h4{font-size:1rem;margin:6px 0;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-step p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:0}

/* feature */
.vrc-feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.vrc-tech-panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42,#0b417d);min-height:410px;border-radius:30px;padding:40px;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-tech-panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -60px 58px 120px;height:6px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:rotate(-12deg)}
.vrc-tech-panel:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:50%;right:-70px;bottom:-70px;box-shadow:0 0 0 45px rgba(255,255,255,.035),0 0 0 90px rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.vrc-tech-panel h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:3.2rem;line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 16px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-tech-panel p{color:#dce9f8;position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:500px}
.vrc-stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:28px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-stat{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:17px;border-radius:15px}
.vrc-stat b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2.1rem;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.vrc-stat span{font-size:.78rem;color:#c8d8eb;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:700}
.vrc-checks{display:grid;gap:15px;margin-top:30px}
.vrc-check{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.vrc-check i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(239,0,23,.09);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--vrc-red);font-style:normal;font-weight:900}
.vrc-check b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-bottom:3px}
.vrc-check span{color:var(--vrc-muted);font-size:.94rem}

/* CTA */
.vrc-cta{background:#061f46;color:white;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vrc-cta:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:70%;height:8px;background:var(--vrc-red);right:-12%;top:38px;transform:skewX(-32deg)}
.vrc-cta-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-cta h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4.7rem);line-height:.95;margin:0}
.vrc-cta p{color:#cbd8e8;max-width:620px}

/* footer */
.vrc-footer{background:#03142f;color:#c8d5e6;padding:56px 0 24px}
.vrc-footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:52px}
.vrc-footer h4{color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.09em;margin:0 0 16px}
.vrc-footer p,.vrc-footer a{font-size:.92rem;color:#aebed2}
.vrc-footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.vrc-footer-logo{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;max-width:260px;margin-bottom:20px}
.vrc-footer-partners{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.vrc-footer-partners img{max-width:130px;max-height:42px;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);opacity:.92}
.vrc-footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-top:42px;padding-top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font-size:.82rem;color:#7f94ae}

/* posts */
.vrc-content{width:var(--vrc-container);margin:60px auto 90px}
.vrc-post-card{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line);padding:28px 0}
.vrc-post-card h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .vrc-hero-grid,.vrc-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-hero-card{max-width:680px}
  .vrc-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
  .vrc-timeline:before{left:19px;right:auto;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;height:auto}
  .vrc-step{text-align:left;padding-left:68px}
  .vrc-step-dot{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;margin:0}
  .vrc-footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:82px;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;padding:14px 20px 24px;box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(6,47,105,.12);flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0}
  .vrc-nav.is-open{display:flex}
  .vrc-nav a{padding:12px 0}
  .vrc-nav a:after{display:none}
  .vrc-menu-toggle{display:block}
}

@media (max-width:680px){
  :root{--vrc-container:min(100% - 28px,1180px)}
  .vrc-section{padding:66px 0}
  .vrc-header-inner{height:72px}
  .vrc-brand img{width:160px}
  .vrc-nav{top:72px}
  .vrc-hero{padding:70px 0 62px}
  .vrc-hero h1{font-size:3.9rem}
  .vrc-hero-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-partners{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:22px 0}
  .vrc-partner-logos{justify-content:flex-start;gap:24px}
  .vrc-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-cta-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
  .vrc-footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-footer-bottom{flex-direction:column}
}

/* v1.2 content system */
.vrc-hero-sub{margin:-8px 0 14px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em}
.vrc-two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:70px;align-items:start}
.vrc-copy-lg{font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-copy-lg p:first-child{margin-top:0}

          <li data-vi="Trung tâm giáo dục" data-en="An education center">Trung tâm giáo dục</li>
          <li data-vi="Tổ chức xã hội hoặc tổ chức phi lợi nhuận" data-en="A social or non-profit organization">Tổ chức xã hội hoặc tổ chức phi lợi nhuận</li>
        </ul>
        <p data-vi="Mỗi tổ chức cần khai báo chính xác tên đơn vị, người phụ trách chính và mối liên hệ với trường hoặc tổ chức trên hệ thống." data-en="Each organization must accurately declare its name, main contact person and relationship to the school or organization in the system.">Mỗi tổ chức cần khai báo chính xác tên đơn vị, người phụ trách chính và mối liên hệ với trường hoặc tổ chức trên hệ thống.</p>

        <h2 data-vi="Hồ sơ xác nhận" data-en="Confirmation documents">Hồ sơ xác nhận</h2>
        <p data-vi="Đối với đội đăng ký dưới tên một trường học, Ban tổ chức có thể yêu cầu:" data-en="For teams registering under a school's name, the organizers may request:">Đối với đội đăng ký dưới tên một trường học, Ban tổ chức có thể yêu cầu:</p>
        <ul>
          <li data-vi="Thư xác nhận của Ban Giám hiệu hoặc đại diện nhà trường" data-en="A confirmation letter from the school's leadership or representative">Thư xác nhận của Ban Giám hiệu hoặc đại diện nhà trường</li>
          <li data-vi="Thông tin của giáo viên hoặc người phụ trách đội" data-en="Information of the teacher or team supervisor">Thông tin của giáo viên hoặc người phụ trách đội</li>
          <li data-vi="Xác nhận nhà trường đồng ý để đội sử dụng tên và thông tin của trường" data-en="Confirmation that the school agrees to let the team use its name and information">Xác nhận nhà trường đồng ý để đội sử dụng tên và thông tin của trường</li>
        </ul>
        <p data-vi="Việc xác minh nhằm bảo vệ nhà trường, bảo đảm thông tin đăng ký chính xác và tránh trường hợp cá nhân tự nhận là đại diện của một đơn vị khi chưa được chấp thuận." data-en="Verification protects the school, ensures accurate registration and prevents individuals from claiming to represent an organization without approval.">Việc xác minh nhằm bảo vệ nhà trường, bảo đảm thông tin đăng ký chính xác và tránh trường hợp cá nhân tự nhận là đại diện của một đơn vị khi chưa được chấp thuận.</p>

        <h2 data-vi="SEPA hỗ trợ gì" data-en="How SEPA helps">SEPA hỗ trợ gì</h2>
        <ul>
          <li data-vi="Tạo tài khoản và đăng ký đội trên RECFEvents.org" data-en="Creating accounts and registering teams on RECFEvents.org">Tạo tài khoản và đăng ký đội trên RECFEvents.org</li>
          <li data-vi="Cập nhật thông tin đội và người phụ trách" data-en="Updating team and supervisor information">Cập nhật thông tin đội và người phụ trách</li>
          <li data-vi="Xuất hóa đơn VAT cho đội thi" data-en="Issuing VAT invoices for teams">Xuất hóa đơn VAT cho đội thi</li>
          <li data-vi="Đăng ký tham gia các sự kiện trong mùa giải" data-en="Registering for events during the season">Đăng ký tham gia các sự kiện trong mùa giải</li>
        </ul>
      </article>

      <aside class="vrc-side-card">
        <span class="vrc-pill" data-vi="Lệ phí mã đội" data-en="Team fee">Lệ phí mã đội</span>
        <div class="vrc-fee"><b>4.600.000</b><span>VND</span></div>
        <p class="vrc-fee-note" data-vi="mỗi đội (cho mã đội thi), đã bao gồm VAT" data-en="per team (for the team code), VAT included">mỗi đội (cho mã đội thi), đã bao gồm VAT</p>
        <a class="vrc-btn vrc-btn--primary vrc-btn--full" href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeEH7g8QBvFNBYgZYCiQ_5u0gCrbdt6IpMadUBhdv6UlqV5Bg/viewform?usp=sharing" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-vi="Đăng ký mã đội →" data-en="Register a team code →">Đăng ký mã đội →</a>
        <hr class="vrc-side-sep">
        <h3 data-vi="Cần hỗ trợ?" data-en="Need help?">Cần hỗ trợ?</h3>
        <p data-vi="Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (Đại diện SEPA)" data-en="Mr. Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (SEPA representative)">Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (Đại diện SEPA)</p>
        <p><a href="tel:+84834899888">+84 834 899 888</a><br><a href="mailto:robotics@sepa.org.vn">robotics@sepa.org.vn</a></p>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- SPONSORSHIP -->
  <section class="vrc-section vrc-section--soft">
    <div class="vrc-container">
      <span class="vrc-kicker" data-vi="Chương trình tài trợ" data-en="Sponsorship program">Chương trình tài trợ</span>
      <h2 class="vrc-section-title" data-vi="SEPA — Lan tỏa STEM" data-en="SEPA — Spreading STEM">SEPA — Lan tỏa STEM</h2>
      <p class="vrc-section-lead" data-vi="SEPA — đại diện quốc tế chính thức của RECF tại Việt Nam — triển khai chương trình tài trợ 10 suất (mức hỗ trợ 50%–100%) chi phí mã đội thi cho các đội Robotics trên toàn quốc. Áp dụng cho cả 3 giải đấu: RECF Engage, RECF Achieve và RECF Inspire."
         data-en="SEPA — RECF's official International Authorized Representative in Vietnam — runs a sponsorship program offering 10 grants (50%–100% support) toward team-code fees for robotics teams nationwide. Applicable to all three programs: RECF Engage, RECF Achieve and RECF Inspire.">SEPA — đại diện quốc tế chính thức của RECF tại Việt Nam — triển khai chương trình tài trợ 10 suất (mức hỗ trợ 50%–100%) chi phí mã đội thi cho các đội Robotics trên toàn quốc. Áp dụng cho cả 3 giải đấu: RECF Engage, RECF Achieve và RECF Inspire.</p>

      <div class="vrc-spon-grid">
        <article class="vrc-spon-card">
          <h3 data-vi="Tiêu chí xét chọn" data-en="Selection criteria">Tiêu chí xét chọn</h3>
          <p class="vrc-spon-sub" data-vi="Chỉ cần đáp ứng 1 trong 3:" data-en="Meet just 1 of 3:">Chỉ cần đáp ứng 1 trong 3:</p>
          <ul>
            <li data-vi="Thiết kế, lắp ráp, lập trình robot hoặc từng tham gia/đạt giải tại các cuộc thi Robotics." data-en="Have designed, assembled or programmed robots, or previously joined/won robotics competitions.">Thiết kế, lắp ráp, lập trình robot hoặc từng tham gia/đạt giải tại các cuộc thi Robotics.</li>
            <li data-vi="Đội thuộc trường vùng khó khăn, vùng sâu vùng xa hoặc học sinh có hoàn cảnh đặc biệt khó khăn vươn lên đam mê STEM." data-en="Teams from disadvantaged or remote-area schools, or students overcoming special hardship to pursue STEM.">Đội thuộc trường vùng khó khăn, vùng sâu vùng xa hoặc học sinh có hoàn cảnh đặc biệt khó khăn vươn lên đam mê STEM.</li>
            <li data-vi="Tích cực tổ chức hoặc tham gia các hoạt động lan tỏa giáo dục STEM tại nhà trường và địa phương." data-en="Actively organize or take part in activities spreading STEM education at school and locally.">Tích cực tổ chức hoặc tham gia các hoạt động lan tỏa giáo dục STEM tại nhà trường và địa phương.</li>
          </ul>
        </article>
        <article class="vrc-spon-card">
          <h3 data-vi="Hồ sơ đăng ký" data-en="Application">Hồ sơ đăng ký</h3>
          <p class="vrc-spon-sub" data-vi="Chọn 1 trong 2 hình thức:" data-en="Choose 1 of 2 formats:">Chọn 1 trong 2 hình thức:</p>
          <ul>
            <li data-vi="Video (2–3 phút): giới thiệu đội, câu chuyện vượt khó hoặc các hoạt động STEM cộng đồng." data-en="Video (2–3 min): introduce the team, a story of overcoming hardship, or community STEM activities.">Video (2–3 phút): giới thiệu đội, câu chuyện vượt khó hoặc các hoạt động STEM cộng đồng.</li>
            <li data-vi="Bài viết (dưới 1.000 từ + 3–5 ảnh): mô tả hành trình đam mê và kế hoạch chế tạo robot." data-en="Article (under 1,000 words + 3–5 photos): describe the team's passion journey and robot-building plan.">Bài viết (dưới 1.000 từ + 3–5 ảnh): mô tả hành trình đam mê và kế hoạch chế tạo robot.</li>
          </ul>
          <p class="vrc-spon-note" data-vi="Lưu ý: Đội đăng ký theo trường cần có Thư xác nhận từ Ban Giám hiệu và người giám sát trên 18 tuổi đồng hành suốt mùa giải." data-en="Note: teams registering under a school need a confirmation letter from school leadership and a supervisor over 18 accompanying them throughout the season.">Lưu ý: Đội đăng ký theo trường cần có Thư xác nhận từ Ban Giám hiệu và người giám sát trên 18 tuổi đồng hành suốt mùa giải.</p>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="vrc-spon-actions">
        <a class="vrc-btn vrc-btn--primary" href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSew66vRpmnRVNXmx4_uMflHD8MXfz_FGV4RhObl6WRgwJbl_A/viewform" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-vi="Đăng ký nhận tài trợ →" data-en="Apply for sponsorship →">Đăng ký nhận tài trợ →</a>
        <a class="vrc-btn vrc-btn--ghost-dark" href="https://docs.google.com/file/d/1PaaYP2a6YajvBdS9iF3Cp9C8vK9EFisg/edit?usp=docslist_api&filetype=msword" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-vi="Mẫu giấy cam kết nhà trường" data-en="School commitment letter template">Mẫu giấy cam kết nhà trường</a>
      </div>

      <div class="vrc-info-callout vrc-info-callout--soft">
        <b data-vi="Tiếp nhận hồ sơ" data-en="Applications received by">Tiếp nhận hồ sơ</b>
        <span data-vi="Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (Đại diện SEPA) · Hotline +84 834 899 888 · robotics@sepa.org.vn / nguyenmanhcuong@sepa.org.vn"
              data-en="Mr. Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (SEPA representative) · Hotline +84 834 899 888 · robotics@sepa.org.vn / nguyenmanhcuong@sepa.org.vn">Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường (Đại diện SEPA) · Hotline +84 834 899 888 · robotics@sepa.org.vn / nguyenmanhcuong@sepa.org.vn</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

</main>

  <footer class="vrc-footer"><div class="vrc-container">
      <div class="vrc-footer-grid">
        <div><p>Vietnam Robotics Championship 2026–2027 — cuộc thi robotics giáo dục lấy học sinh, sinh viên làm trung tâm, triển khai theo hệ thống RECF tại Việt Nam.</p></div>
        <div><h4>Hệ thống & đơn vị tổ chức</h4><p>Robotics Education & Competition Foundation (RECF)</p><p>Trung tâm Hỗ trợ Khởi nghiệp Sáng tạo Quốc gia (NSSC)</p><p>Liên minh Thúc đẩy Giáo dục STEM (SEPA)</p></div>
        <div><h4>Liên hệ</h4><p>Thầy Nguyễn Mạnh Cường<br><a href="tel:+84834899888">+84 834 899 888</a></p><p><a href="mailto:robotics@sepa.org.vn">robotics@sepa.org.vn</a></p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="vrc-footer-bottom"><span>© 2026 Vietnam Robotics Championship.</span><span>Design • Build • Code • Compete</span></div>
    </div></footer>
<script>(function(){var b=document.querySelector('.vrc-menu-toggle'),n=document.querySelector('.vrc-nav');if(b&&n){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=n.classList.toggle('is-open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o?'true':'false');});}})();</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.getElementById('vrc-gt');
  if(!root) return;
  var btns = root.querySelectorAll('.vrc-lang-btn');
  function setLang(lang){
    root.setAttribute('data-lang', lang);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', lang);
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-vi][data-en]').forEach(function(el){
      var v = el.getAttribute('data-'+lang);
      if(v !== null){
        var a=el.querySelector('a');
        if(a && (el.tagName==='P')){ el.childNodes[0].nodeValue=v; }
        else { el.innerHTML=v; }
      }
    });
    btns.forEach(function(b){ var on=b.getAttribute('data-lang')===lang; b.classList.toggle('is-active',on); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false'); });
    try{localStorage.setItem('vrcLang',lang);}catch(e){}
  }
  btns.forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click',function(){ setLang(b.getAttribute('data-lang')); }); });
  var saved='vi'; try{saved=localStorage.getItem('vrcLang')||'vi';}catch(e){}
  setLang(saved);
})();
</script>
</body></html>

<!-- wp:html -->
<!doctype html><html lang="vi"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Lịch trình giải quốc gia — Vietnam Robotics Championship 2026–2027</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --vrc-navy:#062f69;
  --vrc-navy-2:#0a407f;
  --vrc-red:#ef0017;
  --vrc-red-2:#c80016;
  --vrc-ink:#10233e;
  --vrc-muted:#667085;
  --vrc-line:#dce5ef;
  --vrc-bg:#f5f8fc;
  --vrc-white:#ffffff;
  --vrc-radius:22px;
  --vrc-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(6,47,105,.14);
  --vrc-container:min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;color:var(--vrc-ink);background:var(--vrc-white);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;line-height:1.6}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}

.vrc-container{width:var(--vrc-container);margin-inline:auto}
.vrc-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-kicker:before{content:"";width:34px;height:3px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:skewX(-28deg)}
.vrc-section{padding:88px 0}
.vrc-section--soft{background:var(--vrc-bg)}
.vrc-section-title{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.4rem);line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:12px 0 18px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-section-lead{max-width:760px;color:var(--vrc-muted);font-size:1.08rem;margin:0}

/* header */
.vrc-site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(6,47,105,.10)}
.vrc-header-inner{height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.vrc-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:210px}
.vrc-brand img{width:205px;max-height:62px;object-fit:contain}
.vrc-nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;font-weight:700;color:#17375d;font-size:.88rem}
.vrc-nav a{position:relative;padding:28px 0;white-space:nowrap}
.vrc-nav a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:20px;height:3px;background:var(--vrc-red);transition:.22s}
.vrc-nav a:hover:after{right:0}
.vrc-header-cta{padding:12px 18px!important;background:var(--vrc-red);color:white;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(239,0,23,.18)}
.vrc-header-cta:after{display:none}
.vrc-menu-toggle{display:none;margin-left:auto;background:var(--vrc-navy);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px}

/* hero */
.vrc-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 78% 18%,rgba(239,0,23,.17),transparent 28%),
  linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42 0%,#062f69 55%,#0a407f 100%);color:white;padding:96px 0 86px}
.vrc-hero:before,.vrc-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;transform:skewX(-32deg);opacity:.95}
.vrc-hero:before{width:580px;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);right:-80px;top:140px}
.vrc-hero:after{width:430px;height:3px;background:#fff;right:35px;top:168px;opacity:.55}
.vrc-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.18fr .82fr;align-items:center;gap:70px}
.vrc-season{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vrc-season-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--vrc-red);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(239,0,23,.14)}
.vrc-hero h1{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(4rem,8.2vw,7.4rem);line-height:.82;margin:24px 0 22px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.005em}
.vrc-hero h1 span{display:block;color:#fff}
.vrc-hero h1 strong{color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-hero-copy{font-size:1.12rem;max-width:720px;color:#dbe8f7}
.vrc-hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:32px}
.vrc-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 21px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;transition:.2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.vrc-btn--primary{background:var(--vrc-red);color:white;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(239,0,23,.27)}
.vrc-btn--primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#ff1328}
.vrc-btn--ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);color:white;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.vrc-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.vrc-hero-card{position:relative;background:white;border-radius:28px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.24);transform:rotate(1deg)}
.vrc-hero-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:82px;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);top:-4px;right:28px;transform:skewX(-30deg)}
.vrc-hero-logo{width:100%;max-width:560px;margin:auto}
.vrc-hero-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.vrc-meta-box{padding:12px 10px;border-radius:12px;background:#f4f7fb;text-align:center;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-meta-box b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:1.55rem;line-height:1}
.vrc-meta-box span{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:#60718a;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}

/* partners */
.vrc-partner-strip{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line);background:#fff}
.vrc-partners{min-height:116px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.vrc-partner-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7a8798}
.vrc-partner-logos{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:42px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vrc-partner-logos img{max-width:172px;max-height:55px;object-fit:contain}

/* program cards */
.vrc-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:42px}
.vrc-card{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:var(--vrc-radius);padding:28px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(6,47,105,.05);transition:.2s}
.vrc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vrc-navy),var(--vrc-red))}
.vrc-card-no{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:4.6rem;line-height:1;color:#e8eef6;position:absolute;right:18px;top:8px;font-weight:800}
.vrc-card h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;margin:12px 0 10px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-pill{display:inline-flex;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef4fb;color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vrc-card p{color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:14px 0 0}

/* timeline */
.vrc-timeline{margin-top:46px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;position:relative}
.vrc-timeline:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:5%;right:5%;top:19px;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vrc-navy),var(--vrc-red))}
.vrc-step{position:relative;padding:0 16px 18px;text-align:center}
.vrc-step-dot{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--vrc-navy);margin:0 auto 16px;position:relative;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #f5f8fc}
.vrc-step:last-child .vrc-step-dot{border-color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-step time{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--vrc-red);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.vrc-step h4{font-size:1rem;margin:6px 0;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-step p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:0}

/* feature */
.vrc-feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.vrc-tech-panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42,#0b417d);min-height:410px;border-radius:30px;padding:40px;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-tech-panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -60px 58px 120px;height:6px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:rotate(-12deg)}
.vrc-tech-panel:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:50%;right:-70px;bottom:-70px;box-shadow:0 0 0 45px rgba(255,255,255,.035),0 0 0 90px rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.vrc-tech-panel h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:3.2rem;line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 16px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-tech-panel p{color:#dce9f8;position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:500px}
.vrc-stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:28px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-stat{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:17px;border-radius:15px}
.vrc-stat b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2.1rem;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.vrc-stat span{font-size:.78rem;color:#c8d8eb;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:700}
.vrc-checks{display:grid;gap:15px;margin-top:30px}
.vrc-check{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.vrc-check i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(239,0,23,.09);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--vrc-red);font-style:normal;font-weight:900}
.vrc-check b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-bottom:3px}
.vrc-check span{color:var(--vrc-muted);font-size:.94rem}

/* CTA */
.vrc-cta{background:#061f46;color:white;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vrc-cta:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:70%;height:8px;background:var(--vrc-red);right:-12%;top:38px;transform:skewX(-32deg)}
.vrc-cta-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-cta h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4.7rem);line-height:.95;margin:0}
.vrc-cta p{color:#cbd8e8;max-width:620px}

/* footer */
.vrc-footer{background:#03142f;color:#c8d5e6;padding:56px 0 24px}
.vrc-footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:52px}
.vrc-footer h4{color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.09em;margin:0 0 16px}
.vrc-footer p,.vrc-footer a{font-size:.92rem;color:#aebed2}
.vrc-footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.vrc-footer-logo{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;max-width:260px;margin-bottom:20px}
.vrc-footer-partners{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.vrc-footer-partners img{max-width:130px;max-height:42px;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);opacity:.92}
.vrc-footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-top:42px;padding-top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font-size:.82rem;color:#7f94ae}

/* posts */
.vrc-content{width:var(--vrc-container);margin:60px auto 90px}
.vrc-post-card{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line);padding:28px 0}
.vrc-post-card h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--vrc-navy)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .vrc-hero-grid,.vrc-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-hero-card{max-width:680px}
  .vrc-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
  .vrc-timeline:before{left:19px;right:auto;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;height:auto}
  .vrc-step{text-align:left;padding-left:68px}
  .vrc-step-dot{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;margin:0}
  .vrc-footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:82px;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;padding:14px 20px 24px;box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(6,47,105,.12);flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0}
  .vrc-nav.is-open{display:flex}
  .vrc-nav a{padding:12px 0}
  .vrc-nav a:after{display:none}
  .vrc-menu-toggle{display:block}
}

@media (max-width:680px){
  :root{--vrc-container:min(100% - 28px,1180px)}
  .vrc-section{padding:66px 0}
  .vrc-header-inner{height:72px}
  .vrc-brand img{width:160px}
  .vrc-nav{top:72px}
  .vrc-hero{padding:70px 0 62px}
  .vrc-hero h1{font-size:3.9rem}
  .vrc-hero-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-partners{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:22px 0}
  .vrc-partner-logos{justify-content:flex-start;gap:24px}
  .vrc-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-cta-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
  .vrc-footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-footer-bottom{flex-direction:column}
}

/* v1.2 content system */
.vrc-hero-sub{margin:-8px 0 14px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em}
.vrc-two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:70px;align-items:start}
.vrc-copy-lg{font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-copy-lg p:first-child{margin-top:0}
.vrc-text-link,.vrc-card-link{display:inline-flex;margin-top:18px;color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-text-link:hover,.vrc-card-link:hover{color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-card-image{height:180px;margin:-28px -28px 22px;overflow:hidden;background:#eaf0f7}
.vrc-card-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.vrc-program-cards .vrc-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.vrc-program-cards .vrc-card-link{margin-top:auto;padding-top:18px}
.vrc-event-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:52px;align-items:center}
.vrc-event-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin:30px 0}
.vrc-event-facts div{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:14px;padding:15px 16px;background:#fff}
.vrc-event-facts span{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:#7b8797;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800}
.vrc-event-facts b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-top:4px}
.vrc-event-image{border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-event-image img{width:100%;min-height:460px;object-fit:cover}
.vrc-btn--navy{background:var(--vrc-navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(6,47,105,.18)}
.vrc-btn--navy:hover{background:#0a407f;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.vrc-timeline--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.vrc-resource-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:36px}
.vrc-resource-card{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:7px;background:#fff;transition:.2s}
.vrc-resource-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--vrc-shadow)}
.vrc-resource-card span{grid-column:1 / -1;color:var(--vrc-red);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800}
.vrc-resource-card b{color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-resource-card i{font-style:normal;color:var(--vrc-red);font-size:1.3rem}
.vrc-news-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-news-card{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(6,47,105,.05)}
.vrc-news-card>img{width:100%;height:190px;object-fit:cover}
.vrc-news-body{padding:22px}
.vrc-news-body time{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.vrc-news-body h3{color:var(--vrc-navy);line-height:1.25;margin:8px 0;font-size:1.18rem}
.vrc-news-body p{color:var(--vrc-muted);margin:0}
.vrc-news-body>a{display:inline-flex;margin-top:14px;color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800}
.vrc-partner-groups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-partner-groups>div{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;min-height:150px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.vrc-partner-groups span{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:800;color:#7a8798}
.vrc-partner-groups img{max-width:190px;max-height:60px;object-fit:contain;margin-top:24px}
.vrc-cta-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.vrc-cta-note{font-size:.82rem;color:#cbd8e8}

/* inner pages */
.vrc-page-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#041d42,#062f69 65%,#0a407f);color:#fff;padding:74px 0 68px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vrc-page-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-8%;top:38%;width:55%;height:7px;background:var(--vrc-red);transform:skewX(-30deg)}
.vrc-page-hero .vrc-kicker{color:#fff}
.vrc-page-hero h1{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,7vw,6rem);line-height:.92;text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0;color:#fff;position:relative;z-index:2}
.vrc-page-hero p{font-size:1.12rem;color:#dbe8f7;position:relative;z-index:2;margin:0}
.vrc-content-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(260px,.7fr);gap:60px;align-items:start}
.vrc-prose{font-size:1.02rem;color:#37475d}
.vrc-prose h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:2.1rem;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;margin:34px 0 14px}
.vrc-prose h2:first-child{margin-top:0}
.vrc-prose ul{padding-left:22px}
.vrc-prose li{margin:7px 0}
.vrc-side-card{background:var(--vrc-bg);border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;position:sticky;top:110px}
.vrc-side-card h3{color:var(--vrc-navy);font-size:1.3rem;margin-top:0}
.vrc-side-card ul{padding-left:20px;margin-bottom:0}
.vrc-side-card--image img{border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:18px}
.vrc-info-callout{margin-top:28px;padding:20px;border-left:5px solid var(--vrc-red);background:#f7f9fc;border-radius:0 14px 14px 0}
.vrc-info-callout b{display:block;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-bottom:5px}
.vrc-info-callout span{color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-org-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:36px}
.vrc-org-grid article{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px}
.vrc-org-grid img{height:55px;max-width:190px;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:25px}
.vrc-org-grid h3{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--vrc-navy);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.vrc-org-grid p{color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-number-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-number-grid div{padding:24px;background:var(--vrc-navy);border-radius:18px;color:#fff}
.vrc-number-grid b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2.8rem;line-height:1}
.vrc-number-grid span{display:block;color:#d7e4f3;margin-top:8px;font-size:.88rem}
.vrc-icon-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:30px}
.vrc-icon-list div{padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;font-weight:700;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-note{margin-top:24px;color:var(--vrc-muted);font-style:italic}
.vrc-link-box{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-top:28px;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:14px;background:#f7f9fc}
.vrc-link-box span{font-weight:700;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-link-box a{color:var(--vrc-red);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.vrc-roadmap-list{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:34px}
.vrc-roadmap-list article{display:grid;grid-template-columns:140px 240px 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:start;padding:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--vrc-line)}
.vrc-roadmap-list article:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line)}
.vrc-roadmap-list b{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-roadmap-list h3{margin:0;color:var(--vrc-navy)}
.vrc-roadmap-list p{margin:0;color:var(--vrc-muted)}
.vrc-doc-groups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px}
.vrc-doc-groups section{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px;background:#fff}
.vrc-doc-groups h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vrc-navy);margin-top:0}
.vrc-doc-groups a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--vrc-line);padding:13px 0;font-weight:700;color:#31445d}
.vrc-doc-groups a:hover{color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-price-card{background:var(--vrc-navy);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;margin:28px 0}
.vrc-price-card span,.vrc-price-card small{display:block;color:#d9e5f4}
.vrc-price-card b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1.05;margin:6px 0}
.vrc-action-row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:24px}
.vrc-contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px}
.vrc-contact-card{border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;background:#fff}
.vrc-contact-card h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;color:var(--vrc-navy);text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2.2rem;margin:0 0 18px}
.vrc-contact-card p span{display:block;color:#7a8798;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px}
.vrc-contact-card a{color:var(--vrc-navy);font-weight:700}
.vrc-contact-card a:hover{color:var(--vrc-red)}
.vrc-empty-state{grid-column:1/-1;padding:40px;border:1px dashed #bbc7d5;border-radius:18px;color:var(--vrc-muted)}

@media (max-width:1100px){
  .vrc-nav{gap:10px;font-size:.8rem}
  .vrc-brand{min-width:170px}.vrc-brand img{width:165px}
}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .vrc-two-col,.vrc-event-grid,.vrc-content-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-resource-grid,.vrc-news-grid,.vrc-partner-groups,.vrc-org-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .vrc-number-grid,.vrc-icon-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .vrc-roadmap-list article{grid-template-columns:120px 1fr}.vrc-roadmap-list p{grid-column:2}
  .vrc-side-card{position:static}
  .vrc-cta-actions{align-items:flex-start}
}
@media (max-width:680px){
  .vrc-event-facts,.vrc-resource-grid,.vrc-news-grid,.vrc-partner-groups,.vrc-org-grid,.vrc-number-grid,.vrc-icon-list,.vrc-doc-groups,.vrc-contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vrc-roadmap-list article{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.vrc-roadmap-list p{grid-column:auto}
  .vrc-link-box{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
  .vrc-event-image img{min-height:280px}
}

/* Language toggle (Giới thiệu / bilingual pages) */
.vrc-lang-toggle{position:absolute;top:22px;right:20px;z-index:5;display:inline-flex;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:999px;padding:4px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.vrc-lang-btn{appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;color:#dbe8f7;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;line-height:1}
.vrc-lang-btn:hover{color:#fff}
.vrc-lang-btn.is-active{background:var(--vrc-red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(239,0,23,.3)}
@media(max-width:600px){.vrc-lang-toggle{top:14px;right:14px}.vrc-lang-btn{padding:6px 13px;font-size:.78rem}}

/* Detailed organization blocks (Giới thiệu) */
.vrc-org-detail{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--vrc-line);border-radius:var(--vrc-radius);padding:32px;margin-top:26px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(6,47,105,.05)}
.vrc-org-detail:first-of-type{margin-top:36px}
.vrc-org-detail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding-bottom:20px;margin-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vrc-line)}
.vrc-org-detail-head img{height:66px;max-width:220px;object-fit:contain;flex:none}

<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.getElementById('vrc-gt');
  if(!root) return;
  var btns = root.querySelectorAll('.vrc-lang-btn');
  function setLang(lang){
    root.setAttribute('data-lang', lang);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', lang);
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-vi][data-en]').forEach(function(el){
      var v = el.getAttribute('data-'+lang);
      if(v !== null && v !== '') el.innerHTML = v;
    });

    try{localStorage.setItem('vrcLang',lang);}catch(e){}
  }
  btns.forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click',function(){ setLang(b.getAttribute('data-lang')); }); });
  var saved='vi'; try{saved=localStorage.getItem('vrcLang')||'vi';}catch(e){}
  setLang(saved);
})();
